**End Handoff**

Dear Customer,

Thank you for bringing the billing discrepancy for your incorrect plan tier to our attention. We have processed a $310 refund to your account for the overbilling that occurred last month, and your plan tier has been retroactively corrected to **GOLD** to align with your contract.

This refund should appear in your transaction history within 3–5 business days. If you do not see it, please reply to this email or contact our billing team directly.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Let us know if you have any further questions regarding this issue.

Best regards,
The [Company] Support Team
Ticket Reference: C-4762
